verdict.rationale: GitHub explicitly offers CI/CD via Actions, a documented CLI, and API/MCP server for headless automation (github-docs-11, github-probe-3, github-probe-4), supporting scripted/agentic workflows outside the UI. However, community reports note recurring GitHub Actions outages and reliability issues that directly affect CI automation (github-comm-18, github-comm-1), so delivery comes with notable reliability caveats.
